latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — AI-powered tool for generating and optimizing press releases for media coverage.

- Instantly creates 10 professional press releases per news/announcement.
- Scores each release by media pickup potential and optimizes headlines and quotes for journalists.
- Recommends distribution strategies, media contacts, and predicts coverage potential by industry.
- Analyzes media coverage trends using Apify scrapers for Google News, Twitter, and Reddit.
- Serves startups, brands, PR agencies, and communications pros seeking more effective media outreach.
